reason: Our painter has done this house for years, my parents know him and are comfortable letting him in while I am in Dubai, and he does it for less. I am not handing the house and two elderly people to a crew from a brand that has only just come to Kochi.
objection: The guarantee is only 3 years and only for bubbling and peeling. After the monsoon our real problem is damp, seepage and fungus on the outside walls, and nothing here says that is covered. Will this company even be in Kochi in 3 years to honour it?
would_change_my_mind: A guarantee that covers damp and seepage on the exterior walls for at least 5 years, in writing.
